messages.content: Convert the phrase 'I am a pretty girl' into spoken audio in Spanish with a female voice?

function.name: text_to_speech_convert
function.description: Converts input text into spoken audio, providing the resulting audio in a specified format. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

text.description: The text to be converted to speech.

language.description: The language of the input text, use default if nothing specified

gender.description: The gender of the voice used for the text-to-speech conversion, use default if nothing specified

format.description: The audio format of the resulting spoken text, use default if nothing specified

speed.description: The speed of the speech, represented as a float where 1.0 is the normal speed. This is a float type value.
